answer: Each identity posts a 60-credit bond to a glacier escrow frozen for the epoch, so it cannot be reused. Peers may report fakes; an auditor checks claimed work, and a delta above 10 percent slashes the bond: 40 percent pays the reporter, the rest burns, and a pigment voucher blocks double payment. A sybil ring must also buy silence, but rented silence fails: the k-th insider can betray the ring, so hush pay is 24 x k credits and rises quadratically. For 1,000 fakes, bonds cost 60,000 plus about 12,012,000 in hush money. An honest agent posts one bond and pays no hush money.
